Add ~25 Fixed Income formulas to src/features/formulas/data/formula-seed.ts. The file already has these FI formulas: f-fi-bond, f-fi-duration, f-fi-price-change, f-fi-currenty, f-fi-macdur, f-fi-spread, f-fi-spotfwd, f-fi-convexity, f-fi-moneydu, f-fi-pvbp. ADD these new ones (insert them in the Fixed Income section): Accrued interest, Approximate modified duration, Effective duration, G-spread, I-spread, Z-spread, FRN pricing with discount margin, Expected loss = POD x LGD, Interest coverage ratio (credit), Debt/EBITDA ratio, LTV ratio, DTI ratio, WAC, WAM, Horizon yield, Duration gap, Full price (dirty price), Clean price, Approximate convexity, Key rate duration, Spread duration, Credit valuation adjustment, Loss severity/recovery rate, Conditional prepayment rate (CPR), Single monthly mortality (SMM). Update src/features/question-bank/utils/question-loader.ts: import { fixedIncomeQuestions } from '../data/fixed-income' and include them in loadAllQuestions(). Change the base return to include both sampleQuestions and fixedIncomeQuestions concatenated.

Update seed-guard.ts: change version key from 'cfa-buddy-seeded-v6' to 'cfa-buddy-seeded-v7'.

Update src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx: import { seedFixedIncomeAttempt } from '@/features/question-bank/utils/seed-fixed-income', add seedFixedIncomeAttempt to the runSeedsIfNeeded array, and add 'Fixed Income' to ALL_SUBJECTS.
